page_title: PDFSeal 🦭 - 100% Private, Fast, In-Browser PDF Toolkit
offline_banner: 🛡️ Offline Mode Active: PDFSeal is processing 100% locally in your browser memory.
brand_subtitle: Sealed locally in your browser memory
merge_desc: Combine two or more PDF files into a single unified document. Drag to reorder.
merge_drop_subtitle: or drag & drop them directly here
merge_selected_hint: Drag items to change merge sequence
organize_desc: Interactive visual grid. Drag cards to reorder, rotate 90°, or remove pages.
organize_drop_subtitle: Single PDF file with multiple pages
split_desc: Select individual pages or enter page ranges to extract into a fresh PDF.
split_drop_subtitle: Extract specific pages with visual selection
watermark_desc: Stamp confidential labels, draft notices, or custom text across all pages.
watermark_drop_subtitle: Add customized text watermark with live preview
sanitize_desc: Deep privacy scrubber. Remove author names, software footprints, and creation timestamps.
sanitize_drop_subtitle: Discover what hidden metadata is leaking inside your document
detected_subtitle: The following information was found embedded in your file
strip_item_3: • Creation Date and Last Modified Date timestamps
feedback_subtitle: Help Sammy make PDFSeal even better!
feedback_body: Encountered a bug or have a feature request? Let us know! Since PDFSeal is an open-source, community-supported tool, every bit of feedback helps.
trust_desc_privacy: Files never leave your browser. We literally have NO backend servers to view or store your data.
trust_desc_speed: Zero waiting in upload queues. Heavy files are processed in milliseconds in your browser RAM.
trust_desc_honest: No 2-files daily limit, no account sign-up traps, and zero forced $12/month subscriptions.
pwd_modal_desc: This document is encrypted. Enter the password to unlock and process it locally in your browser.
pwd_modal_privacy_hint: 🔒 Your password stays in local memory and is never sent to any server.
pwd_error_wrong: Incorrect password. Please verify and try again.
alert_min_2_files: Please select at least 2 PDF files to merge.
alert_cannot_delete_last_page: Cannot delete the only remaining page.
vault_desc: 100% in-browser client-side IndexedDB storage with zero server uploads, folder organization, and instant tool dispatching.
vault_empty_desc: Imported or processed PDFs will be safely stored here for fast folder organization and one-click tool dispatch.
vault_no_search_desc: Try searching for a different filename keyword.
vault_confirm_delete_file: Are you sure you want to delete this file?
vault_confirm_clear_all: Are you sure you want to clear all files and folders in your vault?
vault_confirm_delete_folder: Delete this folder? Its files will be moved to Default Vault.
dup_modal_desc: This file's content already exists in your local vault. No need to store duplicates or waste disk space.
dup_storage_saved_hint: 🔒 Local SHA-256 deduplication is active, saving your disk space.
picker_modal_desc: Select PDFs stored in your local browser vault to add to the assembly board
settings_modal_desc: Configure rendering, vault archiving, and defaults. All preferences stay in your local browser.
settings_preserve_watermarks_desc: When enabled, 100% preserves stamps, watermarks and annotations. When disabled, extracts clean core content and strips floating watermarks.
settings_autosave_vault_desc: Merged, split, watermarked, or sanitized PDFs automatically generate archive copies in your local Vault.
settings_default_view_desc: Default display style when opening the Vault.
settings_export_prefix_desc: Prefix prepended automatically to exported filenames.
settings_remember_session_desc: Remember unlocked passwords within the current browser session for seamless tool transitions. Cleared on refresh.
settings_confirm_reset: Are you sure you want to reset all preferences to defaults?
log_modal_desc: Real-time monitoring of security verification, decryption pipelines, and page assembly
log_search_placeholder: Search logs by keyword, tag, filename...
log_live_active: Diagnostic engine active (100% local browser memory sandbox)
picker_modal_desc_single: Select a PDF saved in your local Vault
picker_single_hint: Single-select mode: Click to select, double-click to import
